transcript: This free AI tool lets you connect your Claude Code to any app or any tool that you use, even ones that don't have an official MCP or connector, and it's completely free. It's called CLI-Anything, and it lets your Claude Code build a CLI, or command-line interface, for basically any software that you use, including the local tools that are sitting on your computer right now. All you do is point it at an app or a repo, and then it'll read the code, write its own commands, and even install everything for you completely automatically. With this, your agent can actually control things like Blender, Premiere Pro, Zoom, and even NotebookLM, all directly from your terminal. Plus, since these are all CLI, your agent now uses way fewer tokens than a stack of MCPs usually do. If you guys want the full setup for yourselves, just comment "CLI" below, and I'll send you the link directly.
